specifications.published_rule: Hardware defaults: O measured ideally on every measured register, no basis change; readout_q only on recorded sign/control bits; spent derangement registers read right after their CSWAP
specifications.uniform_rule: obs_readout_q=readout_q on every measured data-qubit bit of every readout of O (every arm, every spent derangement register, the baseline); compiled noisy basis change before every readout of O; derangement_readout mid or end
specifications.basis_change: V maps the bell_tilted target cos(pi/6)|00>+sin(pi/6)|11> to |00>: [CNOT(0->1)] then [Ry(-pi/3) on qubit 0]; eps2 after the CNOT, eps1 after Ry, idle on qubit 1 during Ry; 2 units on the clock; per register read 1 CNOT, 1 one-qubit gate, 1 idle unit
specifications.flips: independent classical flip of each computational-basis bit after V, simulated exactly as an X error before an ideal Z measurement
specifications.flip_correction: uniform (primary): reported value (A^-1)^{(x)M} o of each outcome string, A=[[1-q,q],[q,1-q]] (inverse-confusion correction, unbiased, variance in v and the shot plan); uniform_uncorrected (sensitivity): reported value o
specifications.derangement_timing: mid: spent register read right after its CSWAP; end: every register read at the end with the control, spent register B_k idles (N-1-k)(M+2) units first
specifications.unmitigated_baseline: N=1: one noisy source copy (or one run of the algorithm circuit), O read with the readout rule of the run, no control; duration t_prep (or circuit depth) + t_meas; shots from plan_shots at the target RMSE
specifications.csvs: phase_uniform.csv (uniform), phase_uniform_uncorrected.csv (uniform_uncorrected), phase_baseline.csv (published, uniform, uniform_uncorrected), placement_baseline.csv and channel_physical_baseline.csv (published)
